title: FIFO Geometry
claim: Stock probe allocates an order-2 page block (0x4000 bytes) and initializes a circular set of 16 nodes at base + n*0x400, with each next pointer stored at node + 0x8 and the final pointer returning to base. Candidate node layout places payload at +0x18, yielding 0x3e8 (1000) bytes per node.

evidence.observation: get_free_pages is called with order 2; writes node links at offsets 0x8, 0x408, ... 0x3c08; final link stores base at final node + 0x8.
Decompilation enumerates consecutive links at +0x400 strides and wraparound.
Candidate declares next at +0x8 and payload at +0x18.

evidence.locator: function entry and payload accesses around 0x66e8..0x6728
evidence.observation: Stock helper accesses next at node + 0x8 and payload at node + 0x18.

scope: Richtap shared FIFO used by richtap_update_fifo_data and richtap_rtp_work; offline NX809J stock evidence only.
